description: These 2 things unlock your CHARISMA and make socializing EASY 🔥
transcript: Anybody that's amazing socially understands these two things. If you get this down, you're going to be the kind of person that can walk into any room, set the vibe, and really have people feeling good around you, wanting to get to know you more, wanting to be a part of your life. The first part of this is understanding that 90% of socializing is just your energy. It's not what you're saying. It's not some tactic. It's not some technique. It's not like do this when you do that. It's just like literally do you feel good right now? Are you comfortable in your own skin? Are you expressing yourself with confidence? Do you like yourself? Because we have these things called mirror neurons, just how our brains are developed, we feel people's state of being. You can't pretend. Even if you're trying to put on a good show that you're confident and you're expressive, but deep down you feel anxiety, people are going to feel that energy off of you. So the key is understanding that the worse you feel, the harder you have to try, the more you need tactics and techniques. And when you feel good, you don't have to try at all. You can just let go and express yourself. Now, the second part is understanding that the reason you don't feel good right now is just because of some perspective you're holding on to. You're saying, I'm not good enough yet, only in the future. When this happens, because this happened, I can't feel good. And that's limiting your flow, right? You're saying to yourself, essentially, I'm not valid. I'm not worthy. I'm not good enough. But if you just let go, if you just decided to be like, all those perspectives are nonsense. I don't need to buy into them. I'm good enough as I am. I'm going to have fun. I'm going to express myself. You would feel good.
